title: Residual Current Operaed Circuit - Breaking for Household and Similar Uses, Part 2: Circuit - Breakers with Integral Overcurrent Protection (RCVOs)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12640 (PART 2)) covers Residual Current Operaed Circuit - Breaking for Household and Similar Uses, Part 2: Circuit - Breakers with Integral Overcurrent Protection (RCVOs).
